page_title: NAP 2-1 GEN | Napoli v Genoa 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Lorenzo Lucca receives a sweet pass inside the box from Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
90+2' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) works the corner short.
90+2' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

90' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) starts an individual run, not looking to pass to a teammate, and easily weaves through the defence to get deep inside the box. He shoots low, but misses the goal by a whisker! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
89' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
84' The cross into the penalty area from Valentin Carboni (Genoa) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
83' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) is adjudged offside.
82' Today's match ends for David Neres who will be replaced by Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli).
82' Substitution. Rasmus Hojlund will be replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli).
81' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
78' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
76' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Vitinha will be replaced by Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa).
76' Substitution. Valentin Carboni (Genoa) has come on for Stefano Sabelli.
75' 2 - 1 Goal! Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
74' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) rises high to connect with the ball inside the six-yard box from the corner kick, but his decent header only hits the left post and ricochets away!
74' Napoli force their opponents to concede a corner.

74' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Napoli.
72' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

70' Excellent touch by David Neres (Napoli)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
68' A cross from Morten Thorsby (Genoa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. It's a throw-in for Genoa.
65' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' David Neres (Napoli) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Napoli earn a corner.
63' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
61' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Ruslan Malinovskyi is replaced by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
61' Substitution. Jeff Ekhator leaves the pitch and is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
60' That's unlucky! Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
57' 1 - 1 Frank Anguissa (Napoli) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 1:1.
55' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Good work from Genoa as they win a corner.
55' David Neres (Napoli) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
53' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Scott McTominay, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
52' This shall not pass! Scott McTominay (Napoli) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
50' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matteo Politano.
50' Here is a change. Mathias Olivera is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
47' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
46' The game is over for Alessandro Marcandalli. Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) comes on for the second half.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) commits a rough foul. Federico La Penna stops the game and makes a call. Genoa have a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stanislav Lobotka trots off the pitch and is replaced by Billy Gilmour (Napoli).
41' A cross from a corner kick by Genoa is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
38' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
34' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Brooke Norton-Cuffy laid the ball off to Jeff Ekhator (Genoa), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
32' Nicola Leali displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
28' Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
24' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Napoli are awarded the free kick.
22' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
21' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
20' Scott McTominay (Napoli) plays a through ball but overhits it.
16' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Federico La Penna who sees an offensive foul.
14' Nicola Leali comes off his line to intercept the corner from Matteo Politano (Napoli).
13' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
11' A lofted pass finds Matteo Politano (Napoli) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.
11' A pass out of defence finds Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) in space, he doesn't think twice and releases a shot from long range which flies well wide of the left post.
9' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli), but Nicola Leali is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
8' Scott McTominay (Napoli) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
5' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
3' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
2' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Napoli.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Napoli will kick the game off.
Federico La Penna was nominated as the referee for this game.
